TheRocketMagi Semi - release build
==================================

FILES
  TheRocketMagiSemi_REL.ex5   the Expert Advisor - this is the only file to install
  Manual-EN.pdf               user manual, English
  Manual-LO.pdf               user manual, Lao
  INSTALL.txt                 this file

INSTALL
  1. In MT5: File > Open Data Folder > MQL5 > Experts
  2. Copy TheRocketMagiSemi_REL.ex5 into that folder
  3. Back in MT5: right-click Navigator > Refresh

FIRST RUN
  1. Open a XAUUSD chart and switch it to M5. The EA needs M5.
  2. Drag the EA onto the chart.
  3. In the properties window tick:
       Allow Algo Trading
       Allow DLL imports        (needed for the licence check on a real account)
  4. Press the Algo Trading button on the MT5 toolbar so it turns green.
  5. Read the SETUP CHECK block at the bottom right of the panel and fix every
     line that starts with FIX. When the last line says ALL OK you are ready.

  For the web dashboard, add this address under
  Tools > Options > Expert Advisors > Allow WebRequest:
       https://www.laoforextrader.com
  Then open https://www.laoforextrader.com/semi, sign in with Google and enter
  the account number and the key shown on the EA panel.

SETTINGS
  Only three are exposed: mode at start, first lot, grid step. Everything else
  is locked to the tested configuration. First lot, grid step and the equity
  guard can also be changed at any time from the panel, the MT5 mobile app or
  the dashboard.

  From the phone, place a pending order and type the command in the
  Add comment box:
       gs150   grid step = 150 points   used by the NEXT basket of each side
       eg30    equity guard = 30%       takes effect at once
  The EA deletes that order, applies the value and replies on your phone.
  A grid step below the spread of the moment, or a guard outside 1-100, is
  refused and the EA tells you why. Pending orders of 0.01 / 0.02 / 0.03 lot
  still switch the mode to MANUAL / SEMI / AUTO.

LICENCE
  Strategy Tester / Demo      free, no time limit, no network at all
  Real account, licensed      no time limit
  Real account, unlicensed    10 days from the first run, after which the EA
                              opens no new basket - baskets already open are
                              still managed until they close

  To be licensed, send your MT5 account number. It unlocks within 5 minutes;
  there is no new file to install.

RISK
  This EA averages down and has no stop loss by design. The risk it carries is
  the whole account, not a fixed amount per trade. Use money you can afford to
  lose entirely and keep the first lot small. Past results do not describe the
  future: testing was done on a window in which gold rose strongly, and the
  same settings lost money in other periods.
